Name CUbesat-1
Type CubeSat
Units or mass 3U
Status not launched, expected in 2027
Launcher not launched
Organisation Columbia University
Institution University
Entity Academic / Education
Headquarters US
Oneliner

House a spectrograph capable of capturing spatially resolved spectra of ionized hydrogen (H-alpha) for a range of astronomical bodies.
Description

Educational outreach cube-satellite mission designed to provide accessible and engaging astrophysics education for middle school students in underserved New York City public schools. The 3U satellite will house a spectrograph capable of capturing spatially resolved spectra of ionized hydrogen (H-alpha) for a range of astronomical bodies.
